dct_description_sm: The Black Bear Baiting Areas dataset is comprised of all the polygons that represent the Wildlife Management Units where hunting black bears using bait is permitted. These areas are defined in the Alberta Guide to Hunting Regulations along with additional restrictions: https://open.alberta.ca/publications/1485-4287

Ces zones sont définies dans le Guide des règlements de chasse de l'Alberta ainsi que des restrictions supplémentaires : https://open.alberta.ca/publications/1485-4287
